title: Analogs of absolutely maximally entangled states in nonlocal correlations via the sheaf-theoretic framework and its applications
summary: The foundational work by Bell led to an interest in understanding non-local correlations that arise from entangled states shared between distinct, spacelike-separated parties, which formed a foundation for the theory of quantum information processing. We investigate the question of maximal correlations analogous to the maximally entangled states defined in the entanglement theory of multipartite systems.
